requirement: Live compaction renders a placeholder ('[compaction] {reason}'). It must render the upstream CompactionMessage: a bordered header plus a markdown summary body, produced by the real compaction path.
summary: No compaction part travels the transcript contract end-to-end. The live compaction worker (tui_entry.rs:7949-7970) calls the server and, on success, appends only the plain ASCII line 'compaction complete' via append_transcript; it never renders a rich message. The producer compact_session (server/src/lib.rs:1668) resolves the strategy and returns Json({compacted:true,strategy}) only (:1697, :1726), committing only a durable CompactionCheckpoint - it never persists or streams a compaction message/part. MessageRole (contracts/src/lib.rs:222) has only System|User|Assistant|Tool with no Compaction variant, so a compaction marker cannot be serialized at all (encode_role at storage/src/writer_v2.rs:318 covers only 0..3). list_messages (:1256) attaches only tool parts; list_history_page (:1326) attaches zero typed parts ('Raw history records carry no typed parts'); the live startup fetch is GET /history (tui_entry.rs:1193). The rich models are all dead: CompactionState (native_timeline.rs:382) has only self+test consumers; sessions PartKind::Compaction (sessions/src/part_events.rs:19, decode_kind :101) has only crates/sessions/tests/part_events.rs consumers; nothing emits the 'compaction' part type that native_chat_projection.rs:392 projects into ChatPart::Compaction. ServerEvent (server/src/event_bus.rs:12) has no compaction variant. The gap is producer + cross-crate contract + storage + server route + CLI consumer, not a renderer tweak; the wave58 client-only projection helper was correctly REJECTED as dead and unfaithful to the upstream format. Do not stub.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: There is no Compaction role, so a compaction message cannot be represented in the transcript contract, serialized, or reconstructed by any client. Every downstream layer (storage, server, CLI) is bound to this closed enum.
missing_seams.required_producer: Add a Compaction MessageRole (or an equivalent first-class compaction message/part type) plus MessageRecord support (contracts/src/lib.rs:250) so the compaction artifact can be carried on the wire.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: encode_role maps only 0..3 (System/User/Assistant/Tool); with no Compaction role it cannot persist a compaction message. Any compaction row is unrepresentable in storage.
missing_seams.required_producer: Extend encode_role (and its decode counterpart) for the new Compaction role so the persisted row round-trips.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: compact_session never emits a compaction message/part to any store or stream: it commits only a durable CompactionCheckpoint and returns a bare JSON status. No compaction artifact exists for the client to render.
missing_seams.required_producer: Upon successful compaction, persist and/or stream a compaction message carrying the upstream fields (status, summary, tokens) through the transcript contract so list_messages/list_history_page can return it.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: list_messages attaches only tool parts; list_history_page attaches zero typed parts by design ('Raw history records carry no typed parts, so a client that reloads a transcript cannot tell ...'). Even if a compaction row existed, no route surfaces its typed body to the live client.
missing_seams.required_producer: Attach the compaction part/message to the rows returned by list_messages/list_history_page so the live GET /history fetch receives it.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: ServerEvent has no compaction variant, so a live streaming client cannot learn that a compaction occurred or receive its summary without re-reading history.
missing_seams.required_producer: Add a ServerEvent compaction variant (emitted on successful compaction) if live streaming (not only history reload) is to surface the compaction message.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: The live worker renders only the flat string 'compaction complete'; the startup/history fetch carries no compaction part (see above). There is no live consumer that builds a bordered-header + markdown-body CompactionMessage.
missing_seams.required_producer: Once the server carries the compaction artifact, the live CLI must project it into ChatPart::Compaction{status,summary,tokens} and render the upstream bordered header + markdown body.

missing_seams.why_no_live_consumer: It projects a 'compaction' part type that no server route ever emits; the reason field is invented client-side. This is the rejected wave58 client-only path: faithful upstream compaction carries status/summary/tokens, not a reason string.
missing_seams.required_producer: The server must actually emit the compaction part with upstream-faithful fields; the projection must map status/summary/tokens rather than a synthetic reason.
